title: Correct a factual error in the now-accepted ADR-0016: spikes/wasm-worker-nextjs/ does exist and is directly relevant precedent, contrary to what the ADR's Context section currently states
objective: Self-caught correction, made while planning the Architecture Studio Next.js migration the owner just directed: docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md's Context section states 'no spikes/ directory currently exists on disk' -- this is factually wrong. A non-recursive Glob pattern (spikes/*) used while drafting that ADR matched zero files and was misread as the directory being empty/absent; a recursive Glob (spikes/**/*) and a direct Read of spikes/wasm-worker-nextjs/README.md confirm the directory is real, fully documented, and already proves the exact Rust->Wasm->Dedicated-Worker->Next.js-client-route boundary the Next.js migration (task ARCH-STUDIO-NEXTJS-MIGRATION) needs. Leaving a false factual claim in an accepted architectural document is worse than a small, scoped correction, so this task fixes the sentence before other implementation proceeds. This is a factual correction only, not a reopening of the ADR's Decision/Scope -- nothing about the three-surface scope, the license policy, or the Accepted status changes.
validations: docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md's Context section sentence about spikes/ not existing is replaced with one naming spikes/wasm-worker-nextjs/ as existing, real, already-run precedent (Next.js 16.2.12, App Router, wasm-pack + static-asset + webpackIgnore pattern, proven under both next build/Turbopack and next dev with real headless-browser verification per its own README), and notes this is the pattern the Next.js migration reuses.
No other ADR-0016 text changes -- Status stays Accepted, Decision/Record/three-surface scope untouched; this is a factual correction to Context only.
risks: None beyond the correction itself -- no code, dependency, or scope change.
